julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.title: Julier · Albula · Flüela Graubünden Triangle
julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.slogan: 3 passes in 332 km, topping out at 2383 m
julier-albula-fl-ela-graub-nden-triangle.story: High roads with engineering, rail bridges and clean mountain rhythm. A 332 km loop that starts and ends near Chur, about 6 h 23 of riding. The climbs: Julierpass high road, Albula Pass railway country and Flüelapass high section. It tops out at 2,383 m. Lenzerheide Pass, Albula Pass and Fluela Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It is a high-mountain day.

waypoints.advice: 2284 m, and the road stops climbing. The road climbs 809 m over at least 31 km before it, hard. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Albula Pass railway country.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not. The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 34 km. 882 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2383 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: 71 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 33 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
